theorems.name: Submission.dohr_ratio_tendsto_one_of_pinching
theorems.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < g r ∧ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - δ) * g r) ≤ f r ∧ f r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + δ) * g r)) → Tendsto (fun r => f r / ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
